serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Landlord.Face.Normal Landlord: Well, well, well. If it isn’t my favorite tenant. Landlord: Why the long face? Did something happen? You: Well, actually, I quarreled with my friend… Landlord: Oh~ That’s terrible~ Do you want a handkerchief, perhaps? #Landlord.Face.Unhappy Landlord: {{punch}}Is that what you wanted to hear?! Grow up! I don’t care! #Landlord.Face.Normal Landlord: I swear. You are getting dumber every day. You: … Landlord: So anyway. What did you two quarrel about? You: You said you don’t care, why do you want to know? Landlord: You little! {{punch}} Landlord: You already started the topic so you can just as well finish it! You: I guess… You: She’s a little jealous, that’s all. Landlord: Jealousy, huh… Landlord: As someone who lost all his friends because of jealousy, I understand you well! Landlord: Could it be? {{wi}}No, that’s not possible… {{wi}}but perhaps… Landlord: He had money for the bathroom… You: W-What is it about? Landlord: Are you…{{wi}} perhaps just like me? You: I hope not. Landlord: You said that your friend was jealous, right? What could they be jealous of? Your looks? Definitely not. Your woman? Forget about it, she’s all weird-looking! Your talent? Yeah, you don’t look like the type. Sorry. Landlord: There’s only one logical explanation! A vast amount of money! You: H-How did you figure it out?! Landlord: Oh, please. Do you take me for a fool? Such a thing can’t be hidden from me for long. Landlord: Turns out we are kindred spirits… Ostracized by the society solely because of our wealth… You: I seriously doubt that wealth is the only reason in your case. Landlord: True. I’m also effortlessly handsome. You: … Landlord: Listen, how about we combine our efforts and leave this place, huh? If these masses cannot appreciate us, they don’t deserve us. Is he for real? Do we have the same ambition? I wanted to talk to Annalie about it, but…{{wi}} I can’t believe I’m thinking this…{{wi}} maybe Landlord is a better choice? I can’t deny these similarities… {{wi}}Maybe Landlord is my best shot at leaving this place?
